description: Step 3 of /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.184.html. Only young blocks are from-space; survivors go to a new old block; old blocks stay in place. The off-heap chain splits into young and old; a minor sweep walks the young one (as OTP's sweep_off_heap(p, 0)); old resources' destructors run at the next major. A major collection (today's full copy) runs when old bytes pass a multiple of the last major's result. Gifts graft as old. Signal: the gc event says minor or major; a test retains a growing structure across many collections and pins bytes copied near bytes retained; distiller 32,000-line run: copied 6,352 MB -> under 400 MB predicted, collection share 28% -> under 5%, peak RSS 3.3 GB -> under 400 MB. title: A minor collection copies only what was allocated since the last one
